name: pico
description: A small, durable, local-first agent runtime

scripts.dev: npm run plugins:build && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.build: npm run plugins:build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/executor/agent.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:node:* --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/executor-agent.mjs && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}' 'test/**/*.ts' 'plugins/**/*.{ts,tsx,mjs,md,html}' '!plugins/**/runtime.mjs' README.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig*.json vite.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}' 'test/**/*.ts' 'plugins/**/*.{ts,tsx,mjs,md,html}' '!plugins/**/runtime.mjs' README.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig*.json vite.config.ts eslint.config.js
